notes.title: Leaderboard
notes.content:
Added Leaderboard

There is now a leaderboard that will show your score.

What is the score?
The score counts how many unique items you have. It does not count things like tickets or gold. Only items that appear in the in-game inventory are counted.

Example:
2 x Stones
3 x Sticks
1 x Clock

---> Score: 3

For now it is only visible in the steam community tab. It will later be added in-game.

notes.title: Small update and bug fix
notes.content:
Small Update

Bug Fixes  
- Fixed a visual bug that would temporarily decrease the ticket count by 2 instead of 1.  

Changes  
- Removed Lucky Wheel and Merchant items info from the log, as inevitable inconsistencies from the Steam item server led to players believing they lost tickets without receiving a prize.  
- The log is now minimized by default as it contains less information.  
- The inventory layout was updated. It is now sorted and grouped by drop pool to provide a better overview.  
- Merchant sell recipes are now ordered from newest to oldest items and grouped by rarity.

Other  
The code is now compiled in IL2CPP to make reverse engineering harder and enable Linux support in the future.

notes.title: Merchant Update
notes.content:
Merchant Update!

This new update finally brings you the merchant! He will buy sets of items from you for coin bags. There are also two new achievements with the merchant and we now have an in-game "FAQ". And some other small changes and fixes.

Merchant:

 The merchant buys item sets from you. Do you have items you want to get rid of? Sell them to him for (stackable!) coin bags to free up space.


Info tab:

 A new "info" tab was added to guide new players and explain some features.


New Achievements:

 Two new achievements were added, which can be earned by selling items to the trader.


Other Changes:

 Button states and ticket amounts UI now update every few seconds to ensure they behave correctly.
 Last drop time is now disabled by default, but can be enabled through the (improved) settings.




If you encounter any issues, please open a ⁠support ticket on our discord.

Have fun collecting!

~PixelPulseGames

notes.title: Timer removed / New drops / Bug fixes
notes.content:
New Update!

This new update remove the timer completely, as that feature was not compatible with the steam item server. Also some issues with button states were fixed and the new drop pool was added.

Changes:

 Timer was removed. Instead you can now see the last time you got a ticket.
 The reset button now disappears for some seconds after you interacted with the steam server to make sure the game stays in sync.


New Drop Pool:

 Some items from the old pool were removed and replaced by new ones.


Bug Fixes:

 Button states are now updated correctly when you get a ticket after previously having none.
 Ticket counts should now not show ghost tickets and are updated more frequently.




If you encounter any issues, please open a ⁠support ticket on our discord.

Have fun collecting!

~PixelPulseGames
